preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 200 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Each test case has a string length between 1 and 200.
Each string consists of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The number of output strings matches the number of input strings.

postconditions.expression: all(all(b[i] in a for i in range(len(a))) for a, b in zip(as_, bs))
postconditions.description: Each output string is a permutation of the corresponding input string.

postconditions.expression: all(not is_subsequence(b, 'trygub') for b in bs)
postconditions.description: None of the output strings contain 'trygub' as a subsequence.
